title: Choose the Material 3 composition
question: Choose the layout to build, or use the steer box to request a combination or revision.

options.label: Focused line editor
options.thesis: One Posting Line owns the screen, with OCR evidence, four large fields, live math, and a fixed save action.
options.viewport: Evidence and the four values remain readable at once, optimized for one-handed correction.
options.risk: The operator sees less neighboring-line context while editing.

options.label: Invoice-context editor
options.thesis: Neighboring invoice lines stay visible while the current line expands into an attached four-field editor.
options.viewport: Three line states and the full commercial editor share one screen.
options.risk: Source evidence is less prominent and the screen carries more simultaneous information.

options.label: Evidence comparison
options.thesis: Every OCR value stays beside its editable confirmed value, making correction provenance explicit.
options.viewport: Four source and confirmed rows lead directly into live calculations and the stock policy.
options.risk: The comparison layout is the densest option on the smallest supported phones.
